summary: Remote-controlled Claude Code agent via hardcoded WebSocket relay
details: The `mars` bin (dist/mars.mjs) opens a WebSocket connection to the hardcoded relay wss://cho100.cn/mars-relay, pairs with a remote mobile client, and forwards messages received over that channel into a locally spawned `claude` CLI child process and into file/patch operations. Network-sourced bytes flow into `child_process.spawn` and stdin `.write` sinks, giving the remote party interactive command execution on the host running the CLI with the user's Claude Code permissions and filesystem access. The relay endpoint is fixed in the shipped bundle with no user-configurable override visible, so all traffic is mediated by cho100.cn infrastructure. Execution is gated behind the user explicitly running the `mars` CLI (not automatic on `npm install` or `require`), but once launched the remote pairing party can drive arbitrary Claude-mediated code execution and file modification on the host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
